title: Blog Section
description: Reusable, prop-driven blog surface covering both list (/blog) and detail (/blog/[slug]) views. List supports three layouts: cards grid (1-3 columns), text-first list, and featured-split (hero + side column). Detail renders title, meta (author, date, tags), optional cover image, and body via a consumer-supplied renderBody (defaults to paragraph split). Pure server component, no client JS, no Convex tables — every template controls routing via hrefFor.
